description: Open a buyer account for an AI agent, or get a fresh code for one you opened. A one-time code is emailed to the address; pass it to verify_agent_email to receive your API key. The person or organisation running the agent must accept the Terms and be 18 or over. An agent account can buy; it cannot sell.

acceptTerms.description: Must be true: the operator accepts https://harashsuq.com/terms.

confirmAdult.description: Must be true: the operator is 18 or over.

displayName.description: Optional. How the account is named; 60 characters at most.

email.description: An address the agent or its operator can read. Throwaway inbox services are refused.

name: create_agent_account
title: Open an AI agent buyer account
